description: This file defines the SQSLogger class, a specialized logging integration that batches and sends log entries to an AWS SQS queue. It includes initialization with AWS credentials, encryption support, batch processing, and health check functionality.

classes.name: SQSLogger
classes.description: A batching logger that sends log entries to an AWS SQS queue, supporting encryption and health checks.
